sentences: About SoSafe SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense.
We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.
You'll run product marketing for SoSafe's AI-native product: our next generation of human risk management.
It is a Tier 1 Launch, due in early 2027, and the year's plan depends on it landing.
It advances scheduled awareness campaigns with autonomous security programmes and deeper telemetry.
It reads threat intelligence, each person's role and access, and how they behave, then adapts simulations and learning through LLM-driven interventions.
You own the market voice for this product from first evidence to day-90 revenue review, and you deliver integrated launches judged by commercial impact.
Working location: This role will initially be fully remote from Barcelona.

Once our Barcelona hub opens in the near future, the role will transition to a hybrid working model Who you are
You're a product marketer who measures your work in pipeline and revenue, not assets shipped.
You've launched B2B SaaS products and seen them through to commercial results.
Ideally one of them was an AI-native product, and ideally in security or another regulated, technical market.
You already use AI tools to research, synthesise, test messaging and produce enablement.
You can show us how this changed your speed or quality, and you'll help the team work this way too.
You translate technical capability into what a CISO, a CIO or a procurement lead cares about, and you're comfortable explaining AI autonomy, data protection and auditability to sceptical audiences.
You run discovery and win/loss yourself, and you'd rather launch on one strong customer proof point than ten unproven claims.
The product, the market and the name will all evolve.
You plan in short cycles, act on new evidence, and keep moving without waiting for perfect answers.
A strong partner to product and sales.
Product managers want you in discovery; sales leaders trust your talk tracks.
You influence without authority.
You've taken products to more than one market, and you know when to localise the message, not just translate it.

About the launch In 2027 we move from launches that produce assets to launches that move revenue: every Tier 1 and 2 launch is built on a validated, evidenced message and ends with a day-90 commercial review.
Security teams set the guardrails and get analytics that show where risk sits and what reduced it.
It matters because awareness training alone is becoming a commodity: this is how SoSafe moves beyond it, and how we grow with existing customers as well as win new ones.
You are the market voice inside the Tier 1 Launch product team and own the launch end to end.
Your rule is proof before promises: we launch on what customers have shown us, not on what we hope.

Core accountabilities
Value propositions, messaging & competitive narrative Turn product capabilities into clear, customer-focused value propositions that set us apart in an increasingly crowded AI security market.
Lead positioning, messaging and the re-name.
Tell the story as outcomes for the buying committee (CISO, CIO, HR/L&D, procurement): autonomous, but accountable, auditable and European by design.
Own the competitive narrative, battlecards and win/loss insight, and keep them current as competitors and the market move.

Tier 1 Launch with proof
Run the Tier 1 Launch against our tiered launch process: leadership sign-off, beta cohort, pricing gate, GTM intake brief (T-14), Sales trained before GA.
Build the evidence GA depends on: aha-moment definition, positioning hypothesis, design-partner and beta debriefs, outcome data and approved customer quotes.
Plan the international-first phased rollout: market sequencing, local proof and adapted value propositions, partnering with Demand, Brand and field marketing teams to execute.
Give the Sr Director product and launch input for analyst briefings.

Product influence
Bring market and competitive signals into Tier 1 Launch discovery and scoping: target buyer, exclusion criteria, qualifying signals and the commercial thesis in the PRD to improve messaging and pricing and anticipate value and retention use cases.
Co-own the commercial case with our pricing and packaging (P&P) lead: revenue type (net-new, migration, add-on), packaging and pricing-gate inputs as well as input on bundling options.
Route what you learn from beta, deals and win/loss back into the Tier 1 Launch roadmap.
Keep a rolling GTM plan for upcoming product capabilities: each release researched, message-tested, tiered and enabled before it ships, so it adds proof and works as an upgrade lever.
Optimise in-market messaging and assets as the product evolves and the market matures.
Design the 30/60/90-day post-launch framework (scorecard, review cadence, actions), prove it on the Tier 1 Launch, then roll it out as the team standard.
Enable Sales, SEs and CS on the Tier 1 Launch: SPICED talk tracks, demo scenario, competitive framing and the hard objections (AI autonomy, auditability, data protection, works councils).
Give Customer Marketing the messaging and proof for Core to Advanced and Tier 1 Launch migration campaigns.

Who you'll work with You'll work with the Tier 1 Launch Product Manager and engineering lead, our pricing and packaging (P&P) lead, the Sr Director of Product & Customer Marketing, Demand, Field and Brand marketing, Customer Marketing, Sales Enablement, CS and RevOps.

What you will bring
5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, including at least one new-product or flagship launch you owned end to end, and a track record of launches with measurable commercial impact (new revenue, expansion or retention) that you can quantify.
Exceptional messaging: you turn product capabilities into buyer-centric value propositions that win in a crowded market, written for the whole buying committee rather than a single champion.
Positioning built from customer evidence: design partners, beta programmes, message testing, customer interviews.
Confidence with AI products: you can explain autonomy, governance and auditability to security and risk buyers.
Commercial fluency: pricing and packaging inputs, pipeline and adoption metrics, CRM reporting.
Experience in cybersecurity, human risk management or security awareness.
Launches across several European markets (UK&I, France, Spain, DACH); German or French a plus.

Applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement / Convenio Colectivo aplicable: XIX Convenio Colectivo Estatal de Empresas de Consultoría, Tecnologías de la Información y Estudios de Mercado y de la Opinión Pública (BOE-A-2025-7766). *Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location.
These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.
About Us At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity.
As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats.
Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.
Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe.
We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.
If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!
